fullName: ʿAbd Manāf ibn Quṣayy ibn Kilāb
fullNameCn: 阿卜杜·马纳夫·本·库赛·本·基拉卜
primaryTitle: Quraysh notable and ancestor of major Meccan clans
primaryTitleCn: 古莱什重要祖先及麦加大支系共同祖先

events.label: Inherited a leading position within Quraysh after Quṣayy's generation
events.labelCn: 在库赛一代之后继承古莱什内部的重要地位
events.note: Later Arabic genealogy places ʿAbd Manāf among Quṣayy's principal sons; no secure absolute year can be assigned.

events.label: Became the common ancestor of the Hāshim and ʿAbd Shams lines
events.labelCn: 成为哈希姆支与阿卜杜·沙姆斯支的共同祖先
events.note: Traditional Quraysh genealogy makes Hāshim and ʿAbd Shams sons of ʿAbd Manāf, producing the fork that later links Banū Hāshim and Banū Umayya.

sourceNote: Ibn Isḥāq/Ibn Hishām; al-Ṭabarī; M. J. Kister on Quraysh and Mecca; Wikipedia only as the stable online person index.
notes:
The project's key pre-Islamic fork joining the later Hāshimite and Umayyad target lines.

Confidence / caveats: Chronology and much of the biography derive from later Arabic genealogical and sīra traditions rather than contemporary documentation. Birth and death years are intentionally null; later dynastic outcomes must not be projected backward as if he founded a medieval dynasty.
